response.sql: WITH order_rates AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY o.orderspivot, u.acctscope), scope_rates AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS average_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_rates WHERE net_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY acctscope) SELECT acctscope, average_net_fee_rate, order_count, average_net_fee_rate - AVG(average_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_scope_average FROM scope_rates

assumptions.assumption: The order count includes only orders with a defined net fee rate.

alternatives.interpretation: Count every order with a matched fee record and user, including orders whose net rate is missing; exclude those orders only from the rate average.
